item.title: Kendrick Lamar dominates 68th Grammy Awards as Bad Bunny wins album of year
item.description: The 68th Grammy Awards were held in Los Angeles on Sunday night, with Kendrick Lamar emerging as the ceremony’s biggest winner for the second consecutive year, Azernews reports, citing foreign media.

item.title: Singapore set to form space agency
item.description: Singapore will launch its own national space agency on April 1, aiming to “fully harness the value and opportunities of the rapidly growing global space economy,” the country’s Ministry of Trade and Industry announced on Monday. The ministry will also oversee the operations of the new agency, Azernews reports, citing foreign media.

item.title: Belarus unveils new ruble symbol
item.description: The National Bank of Belarus has officially introduced a new graphic symbol for the national currency, the Belarusian ruble, Azernews reports.

item.title: Trevi Fountain introduces ticket fee
item.description: Starting today, anyone who wants to visit the Trevi Fountain in Rome will need to purchase a ticket, Azernews reports.

item.title: Layoffs without recession: What AI economy is really doing to jobs
item.description: Since the launch of ChatGPT in November 2022, the S&P 500 has climbed more than 70%, while job openings have fallen by roughly 30%. The visual contrast became known online as the “scariest chart in the world,” symbolizing a growing fear: that productivity, profits, and growth may no longer require proportional human employment.The data itself is real. Job openings peaked at 11.5 million in March 2022, the highest level since tracking began in 2000. By August 2025, openings had fallen to about 7.

item.title: Artemis II nears launch with wet dress rehearsal
item.description: NASA has announced that the countdown has officially begun for the wet dress rehearsal of the Artemis II mission to the Moon. On Friday, 30 January 2026, the space agency said it would target Monday, 2 February, for the rehearsal. By Saturday, 31 January, NASA confirmed that the countdown started at 20:13 EST (1 February, 01:13 UTC), marking 48 hours until the first wet dress rehearsal window, Azernews reports, citing foreign media.

item.title: Azerbaijan State Security Service arrests four citizens over Ukraine-Russia conflict
item.description: The State Security Service (SSS) of the Republic of Azerbaijan has launched a comprehensive investigation into citizens participating in illegal armed conflicts outside the country’s borders. These measures aim to identify and hold accountable individuals involved in paramilitary groups not recognized by national legislation, Azernews reports, citing the SSS Press Service.

item.title: Azeri Light prices fall sharply at Augusta and Ceyhan
item.description: The price of Azerbaijan’s Azeri Light crude oil delivered on a CIF basis to Italy’s Augusta port fell by $3.63, or 4.95 percent, compared to the previous assessment, settling at $69.72 per barrel.

item.title: President Ilham Aliyev meets with Secretary General of Muslim Council of Elders in Abu Dhabi
item.description: On February 3, President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev met with Secretary General of the Muslim Council of Elders Mohamed Abdelsalam in Abu Dhabi, Azernews reports.

item.title: Epstein documents allege financial ties to Putin
item.description: Newly released documents linked to the investigation into Jeffrey Epstein have reignited scrutiny over the late financier’s global connections, including unverified claims involving Russian President Vladimir Putin, Azernews reports via People Magazine.
